_readme: Copy this file, fill in the credentials you have, delete nothing else.
Anything left as an empty string is skipped, so a partially filled file is still valid.
This is the same block embedded in all five QA prompts — fill it in once and paste it into each runner.
Provider ids are SDK ids: 'openai-compatible' is any OpenAI-shaped endpoint, 'openai-native' is
api.openai.com. The settings UI labels them 'OpenAI Compatible' and 'OpenAI'.
Apply with: node fixtures/apply-keys.mjs --keys keys.json --dir $QA/data --select anthropic
